question: On the preparation of master formulas and officinal preparations:

options.opa: The preparation of a master formula must be done exclusively by the pharmacist.
options.opb: Sterile preparations can be prepared in the same preparation area for office preparations since the cross contamination is minimal.
options.opc: The elaboration and control of the master formula must be carried out in a room, or in a preparation area, located inside the pharmacy office.
options.opd: Office preparations can be prepared by any person without qualification and without supervision of the pharmacist, since they can consult their preparation in the national form.
